type.label: Project type
type.createTip: Motor: the motor specification and Motors & results. Controller: the controller specification, for internal controller work. Only an admin changes the type later.
type.switchTip: Switches the specification form and the results tab of this project. The data of the other form is kept.
type.confirmBody: The project shows the specification form and the results tab of this type. Nothing stored is deleted; switching back shows the earlier form again.

spec.tipEdit: The requirements to this controller. Every number has its requirement and its source; the model and measured results are entered in the Controller sim tab. Save records what changed.
spec.tipRead: The controller specification of this project. Only the project owner and admins change it.
spec.perBuildTip: One value per build of the Supply step.
spec.noBuilds: Add the builds in step 2 (Supply) first.
spec.statusTip: Requirement: what the controller must reach. Model: the computed result. Measured: from a test on a board (later). Each column has its own source.
spec.conflict: Somebody saved the controller specification in the meantime. Your values are still in the form; reload to see the saved ones (your unsaved values are then discarded).
spec.dropBuildTitle: Remove the build and its values?
spec.dropBuildBody: These builds still hold values (number of fields): {builds}. Removing them deletes those values when you save.

sim.title: Controller sim
sim.tipEdit: The results against the requirements: for every number and protection the requirement from the specification (read-only here), the model result and the measured value, each with its source. MOTRES engineers enter the results; a value that breaks its requirement is marked red.
sim.tipRead: The results against the requirements: the requirement from the specification, the model result and the measured value of every number and protection. MOTRES engineers enter the results.
sim.requirementTip: From the Specification tab, where the project owner and admins change it.
sim.aboveMax: Above the requirement: the requirement is a maximum of {requirement} {unit}.
sim.belowMin: Below the requirement: the requirement is a minimum of {requirement} {unit}.
sim.noProtections: No protection is named in the specification yet.
sim.conflict: Somebody saved the records in the meantime. Your rows are still here; reload to see the saved ones (your unsaved rows are then discarded).
sim.revisionsTip: One row per board revision: its status (draft, frozen, released), its date and the document group in the Documents tab.
sim.testsTip: Each test as it arrives: date, board revision, the measured value, pass or fail against the specification, and where the record is.
sim.pairedMotorTip: The motor linked to this project in the catalog, else what the specification names.
